step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture centers on Amazon Connect as the core contact center service. The visual whiteboard shows multi-path integrations: 1) Connect integrates with a Lambda function that queries a DynamoDB table to retrieve country-specific greetings and configurations. 2) Connect connects to Amazon Lex for natural language understanding. 3) Connect integrates with Amazon Translate, which feeds into Amazon Polly for multi-language text-to-speech response generation. 4) Connect records call audio and stores encrypted audio files directly into Amazon S3. 5) S3 triggers a separate Lambda function that sends the voice files to Amazon Transcribe, which then writes the transcribed text files back to the S3 data lake. 6) Agents/Analysts access and search through the transcribed data in S3. 7) End-user callers interact directly with Amazon Connect.

edges.notes: Callers initiate phone calls to Amazon Connect

Connect saves call voice recording files to S3 bucket
S3 object creation triggers transcription Lambda function
Lambda triggers Transcribe job on the audio recording
Transcribe writes generated text file back to S3 data lake
Agents and auditors search transcribed call text in S3
